results.description:
An advanced tool for network diagnostics, LAN scanning, and problem detection.

Network Analyzer can help you diagnose various problems in your wifi network setup, Internet connectivity, and also detect various issues on remote servers thanks to the wide range of tools it provides.

It is equipped with a fast wifi device discovery tool, including all the LAN device's addresses and names, together with the Bonjour/DLNA services they provide. Further, Network Analyzer contains standard diagnostic tools such as ping, traceroute, port scanner, DNS lookup, whois, and Internet speed tester. Finally, it displays various useful information related to your wifi/cell connection.

WIFI LAN SCANNER 
• Detection of all connected network devices (wifi & VPN) 
• IP addresses of all discovered devices 
• NetBIOS, mDNS (Bonjour​), LLMNR, and DNS name where available 
• Pingability test of discovered devices
• IPv6 availability and discovered IPv6 addresses
• Wake on LAN (WOL) including remote WOL 
• Scan of custom IP ranges 
• Filtering and search in the discovered device list

PING & TRACEROUTE 
• Round trip delay including IP address and hostname for every network node 
• Geolocation data including latitude, longitude, country, city, and time zone 
• AS number and network name information 
• Complete trace route visualization on the map 
• Graphical ping statistics updated in real time
• Configurable ICMP/UDP probes for traceroute
• Configurable ping payload size
• Both IPv4 and IPv6 - selectable

PORT SCANNER
• Scanning the most common ports or user-specified port ranges 
• Detection of closed, firewalled, and open ports 
• Description of the known open port services 
• Scan of complete port range or user-editable common ports
• Both IPv4 and IPv6 - selectable

WHOIS 
• Whois of domains, IP addresses and AS numbers 

DNS LOOKUP
• Functionality similar to nslookup or dig 
• Support of A, AAAA, CAA, CNAME, HINFO, MX, NS, PTR, SOA, SPF, SRV, SSHFP, TXT records
• Decoding and showing DNSSEC records such as DNSKEY, CDNSKEY, RRSIG, NSEC3PARAM, NSEC, NSEC3, DS, CDS, TLSA 

INTERNET SPEED 
• Test of both download and upload speeds
• Graphical speed test view
• Speed test history 

NETWORK INFORMATION
• Default gateway, external IP (v4 and v6), DNS server, HTTP proxy 
• Wifi network information such as SSID, BSSID, IP address, and subnet mask 
• Cell network information such as network type
• Monitor of wifi, cell and VPN data usage (both sent and received data since the last boot) 

LOCAL SERVICE DISCOVERY
• Bonjour service browser
• UPnP/DLNA service and device browser

MORE
• Full IPv6 support everywhere
• History of all performed tasks with the possibility to star the favorite ones 
• Export by email, AirPrint, and AirDrop for most tools
• Light/dark theme
• Copy/paste support 
• Detailed help
• Regular updates

- IPv4/IPv6 calculator with details about addresses, ranges and subnets
- MAC address browser showing details about a MAC address, with custom name and vendor assignment

results.description:
Network Analyzer Pro is a complete network toolkit that turns your iPhone or iPad into a powerful diagnostic instrument. Whether you are troubleshooting a slow connection, tracking down unknown devices, or exploring how the internet routes your traffic, it puts professional-grade tools right in your pocket - no desktop or extra hardware required.

Discover every device on your LAN, watch your traceroute unfold on a world map, measure your real download and upload speeds, work out any subnet with the IP calculator, and diagnose any host with ping, traceroute, port scanning, DNS lookup, and whois. From home users to IT professionals, Network Analyzer Pro delivers everything you need in one polished app.

LAN scanner:
- Fast and reliable detection of all devices on Wi-Fi, VPN, and personal hotspot networks
- IP addresses, MAC addresses, and vendors of all discovered devices
- NetBIOS, mDNS (Bonjour), LLMNR, DNS, SNMP, and WS-Discovery names
- Reachability (ping) test, IPv6 availability, and IPv6 addresses
- Custom device names and vendors, scan history, and favorites
- Quick actions: open the web interface, browse Bonjour and UPnP services, or wake the device
- Wake on LAN (WOL) including remote WOL
- Scan of custom IP ranges, filtering, and search in the device list

Ping & traceroute:
- Round-trip delay, IP address, and hostname for every node
- Selectable ICMP, UDP, and TCP ping and ICMP/UDP traceroute probes
- Configurable probe delay, payload size, TCP port, and don't-fragment flag
- Audible ping
- Geolocation (latitude, longitude, country, city, time zone), AS number, and network name
- Complete traceroute visualization on the map
- Real-time graphical ping statistics

Port scanner:
- Scan common ports, custom ranges, or the complete port range
- Detection of closed, firewalled, and open ports
- Descriptions of known port services
- Editable common port list and adjustable scan rate

Whois:
- Look up domains, IP addresses, and AS numbers
- Classic whois and the modern RDAP protocol, with custom servers

DNS lookup:
- Functionality similar to nslookup or dig
- Query all record types at once or a single type
- A, AAAA, CAA, CNAME, HINFO, LOC, MX, NAPTR, NS, PTR, SOA, SPF, SRV, SSHFP, and TXT records
- DNSSEC records: DNSKEY, CDNSKEY, RRSIG, NSEC3PARAM, NSEC, NSEC3, DS, CDS, TLSA
- Custom DNS server and port, no-recursion option, all response sections

Internet speed:
- Download, upload, and server latency measurement
- Graphical speed test view
- History with full results including graphs, custom names, and notes

IP calculator:
- Details about any IPv4 or IPv6 address, range, or subnet
- Network, broadcast, masks, address count, type, class, IANA block, reverse DNS, supernet, subnet splitting, membership test
- Binary, decimal, hex, and IPv6 forms (expanded, 6to4, NAT64, Teredo, EUI-64)

MAC address browser:
- Vendor lookup (IEEE MA-L, MA-M, MA-S), address type, administration, SLAP quadrant, and known use
- Custom name and vendor assignment used throughout the app

Network information:
- Default gateway, DNS server, HTTP proxy, external IP (v4 and v6) with hostname, AS number, and AS name
- Wi-Fi details: SSID, BSSID, router vendor, security type, IP address, and subnet mask
- VPN, USB Ethernet, and personal hotspot connection details
- Cell network type, with dual SIM support
- Wi-Fi, cell, and VPN data usage since the last boot

Local service discovery:
- Bonjour and UPnP/DLNA browsers

Siri, Shortcuts, and controls:
- Siri, Spotlight, and Shortcuts app support for every tool
- Control Center, Lock Screen, and Action button controls
- Share extension: query any website from Safari
- Home screen quick actions

More:
- No ads
- Light and dark theme
- Full IPv6 support everywhere, with selectable IPv4/IPv6
- History of all performed tasks, with favorites
- Export by email, AirPrint, and AirDrop
- Copy/paste support
- Detailed help
- Regular updates
